topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: V-band is more suitable for dense LEO constellations due to its ability to reduce interference and array factor. In sparse or medium-density constellations, the trade-offs between frequency, atmospheric conditions, and hardware complexity should be considered. V-band is generally more suitable for small satellites due to simpler hardware and lower power requirements, while large satellites may favor V-band for its simpler design and lower power consumption. Optical systems remain more suitable for high-data-rate applications but require more complex hardware and precise alignment mechanisms.
